text.description_html:
Laurey 74710, Aventura Champagne Brass Cabinet Pull

The Aventura Cabinet Pull has 5 inch mounting centers and a beautiful Champagne Brass finish. This Aventura Champagne Brass Cabinet Pull has an easy to care for design, making it an ideal handle for high traffic kitchen cabinets. The 5 Inch Champagne Brass Aventura Cabinet Pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection of transitional cabinet hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74710 128mm Pull Aventura Champagne Brass:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Champagne Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 5" (128mm)
  • Overall Length: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
